title: Subject Pronouns: I, You, He, She, It, We, They
summary: Learn how to use subject pronouns in English. These words help us talk about people, animals, and things easily.

sections.p: When you talk about yourself, use 'I'. When you talk to the person in front of you, use 'you'. These words are the start of many English sentences and are very important for everyday conversations.
We use 'he' for a man or a boy. We use 'she' for a woman or a girl. When we talk about one animal or one thing, we use 'it'. This makes speaking and writing much simpler.
Use 'we' when you are part of a group. Use 'they' when you talk about other people, animals, or things in a group. These pronouns help us talk about more than one person or thing at the same time.

words.mean: more than one person or thing

tip: Point to yourself for 'I' and to your friend for 'you'. Connecting words to body actions helps your brain remember them faster!
